name: RRT External-Only Commercial Signal Policy
principle: RRT must remain useful before first-party access without pretending to know conversion or revenue loss.

NO_SIGNAL.meaning: No defensible external commercial gap found.

WATCHLIST.meaning: A defensible difference exists but commercial pressure is not yet sufficiently corroborated.

OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL.meaning: Externally defensible opportunity: saturated evidence + repeated competitive pressure + discoverability proxy + adversarial survival. It is NOT a claim of proven lead/revenue loss.

promotion_to_opportunity_signal_requires: prospect saturation PASS + evidence re-audit PASS
L1 competitive pressure from >=2 comparable competitors
no strong contradictory public behavior evidence
forbidden_external_claims: causal statement that the communication gap caused economic loss

first_party_upgrade.L3: behavior evidence tied to the exact dimension
